len (Design): Quick sync  noticed a combo problem: autosmoothing + dynamic unit scaling is shifting axis anchors, which hides short spikes near 0. design asks: can we anchor axis to recent baseline when 'preserve spikes' is on?

fletcher (PM): Yes, incidents missed because the axis rescaled; if a short spike jumps from 2 -> 50 units and axis autoscaled, the rest of the trace flattens. Suggest a mode: 'preserve-anchor' that freezes y-axis min for short windows when peaks are detected.

mei (Viz Eng): Prototype idea: when preserve_mode=on and a preserved_peak is found, compute baseline = percentile(25) over last 5m and snap y-min to baseline - 5% of range for 10s. config:
```
preserve_mode: true
anchor_window_secs: 10
baseline_method: p25
anchor_padding_pct: 5
```
This keeps the spike visually distinct without breaking long-term trends.

ran (A11y): Accessibility note: if we change axis anchoring, screen reader summaries must still report absolute values; add aria-live region text when anchoring toggles: "axis anchored to baseline 12ms for 10 seconds". Also preserve spike markers must have aria-labels and keyboard focus.

len (Design): Copy: toggle = "Preserve spikes (anchor axis)" with short tooltip explaining anchor behavior. Legend microcopy: show badge "anchored" when active. Keep chevron to expand advanced settings.

mei (Viz Eng): Performance note: anchoring must be debounced per-panel to avoid frequent reflows. Also cap marker rendering and prefer canvas for markers.

fletcher (PM): Plan: feature-flag on staging, A/B test for two weeks measuring alert recall and false positives. Add telemetry: anchored_count, preserved_peak_count per panel.

mock-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/axis_anchor_preserve_v1.png

len (Design): I'll update the spec and open a PR with QA checklist: axis anchoring behavior, aria-live messages, legend badge, keyboard focus for markers, and stress test for frequent anchors.
